semantics: Planning guidance, not an executable native workflow schema or authority. Select with evidence; materialize only needed work through supported current plan actions.

choices.evidence: Native connected objective/parameter-gradient probe for the chosen family and installed CE capabilities.

branches.reuse_verified: Do not import the CE plan. Record exact CE identity and the executed proof.
branches.extend_cellerator: Import only machine/cellerator.optional.todo-plan.json into CE; supply demand, receive producer evidence, validate installed consumption.

choices.join: GH acceptance waits for the chosen numerical route, not both branches.

choices.evidence: Simplest genuinely learnable partial-observation family exercising shared/local unknowns and native gradients.
choices.join: One primary family plus a small meaningful alternative/control, not three separate implementation projects.

choices.evidence: Actual clone/time/modality/replicate coverage and the exact inference cutoff.
choices.join: Implement one selected arm; other arms remain future configurations, not blocked tasks.

choices.evidence: Verified public input availability and feasible reconstruction of required metadata.
choices.join: Toolkit and client qualification continue independently; absence of biology is explicitly reported, not passed as biological validation.

choices.evidence: A real independent work/ownership boundary with expected net benefit; current role/action capabilities.
choices.join: No fixed delegate count, expensive parallel heads or repeated mandatory observer archaeology.
